title: Design: AccountingHub Sales Invoices shows Closed records with the badge
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have AccountingHub enabled.
  • Have a customer flagged as Internal customer, with one asset, and its default internal category left at General Internal.
  • Have a closed internal work order, made for this test.
  • Open the attached picture iwo-flow5-02-03-accountinghub-sales-invoices.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open Accounting > Sales > Invoices.
  2. Pick Closed in the Status filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The closed work order shows the Closed pill and the Internal badge.

Step 2:

  • Only Closed records are listed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11765 (Story 8, AccountingHub, the closed work order and its parts cost)

  • S8-R6: “The Invoice list report's status filter gets the value Closed, unselected by default, so the default report and its totals are unchanged. The Accounting Sales Invoices page shows Closed records with the Closed pill and the badge, and its Status filter (default All) gets the value Closed; there is no Classification filter in this version.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
